select hbm.BP_ID,hbm.BP_CODE,hbm.BP_NAME,hbm.BP_CLASS,hbm.EXTRA_NAM,hbm.enabled_flag,hbt.description bpClassN,hbpt.description bpTypeN ,su.DESCRIPTION ownerUserIdN, (select hbc.description from hls_bp_category hbc where hbc.bp_category=hbm.bp_category) bp_category_n from hls_bp_master hbm left join hls_business_type hbt on hbm.bp_class = hbt.business_type and hbt.document_category = 'HLS_BP_MASTER' left join hls_bp_type hbpt on hbm.bp_type = hbpt.bp_type left join sys_user su on hbm.owner_user_id = su.user_id
and ( (hbm.bp_code like concat('%', concat(#{queryInfo}, '%'))) or (hbm.bp_name like concat('%', concat(#{queryInfo}, '%'))) or (hbpt.description like concat('%', concat(#{queryInfo}, '%'))) or (hbt.description like concat('%', concat(#{queryInfo}, '%'))) or (hbm.extra_nam like concat('%', concat(#{queryInfo}, '%'))) or EXISTS (SELECT ppb.BP_ID FROM prj_project_bp ppb,prj_project pp where pp.PROJECT_ID= ppb.PROJECT_ID AND ppb.BP_ID = hbm.BP_ID and ( pp.PROJECT_NUMBER like concat('%', concat(#{queryInfo}, '%')) or pp.PROJECT_NAME like concat('%', concat(#{queryInfo}, '%')) ) ) or EXISTS (SELECT ccb.BP_ID FROM con_contract_bp ccb,con_contract cc WHERE ccb.BP_ID = hbm.BP_ID AND cc.contract_id = ccb.contract_id and ( cc.contract_number like concat('%', concat(#{queryInfo}, '%')) or cc.contract_name like concat('%', concat(#{queryInfo}, '%')) ) ) )
order by hbm.creation_date desc

Select hbm.BP_ID, hbm.BP_CODE, hbm.BP_NAME, hbm.BP_CLASS, hbm.EXTRA_NAM, hbm.enabled_flag, hbt.description bp_class_n, hbpt.description bp_type_n, su.user_name owner_user_id_n From con_contract cc, csh_transaction ct, hls_bp_master hbm Left Join hls_business_type hbt On hbm.bp_class = hbt.business_type And hbt.document_category = 'HLS_BP_MASTER' Left Join hls_bp_type hbpt On hbm.bp_type = hbpt.bp_type Left Join sys_user su On hbm.owner_user_id = su.user_id Where (hbm.bp_id = cc.TENANT_ID Or hbm.bp_id = cc.bp_id_vender Or hbm.bp_id = cc.manufacturer_id Or hbm.bp_id = cc.factory_id) And cc.contract_id = ct.contract_id And ct.transaction_id = #{transactionId}

select bp_id,bp_name,bp_code from hls_bp_master hbm
1=1
and hbm.bp_name LIKE concat(CONCAT('%',#{bpName}),'%')
and hbm.bp_code LIKE concat(CONCAT('%',#{bpCode}),'%')

select hbm.bp_id, hbm.bp_code, hbm.bp_name,
(select hbc.description from hls_bp_category hbc where hbc.bp_category = hbm.bp_type) bp_category from hls_bp_master hbm where exists ( select 1 from hls_bp_master_role hbmr where hbmr.bp_id = hbm.bp_id and hbmr.bp_type in ('VENDER','DEALER','MANAGEMENT_COMPANY') and hbmr.enabled_flag = 'Y' )
and hbm.bp_name LIKE concat(CONCAT('%',#{bpName}),'%')
and hbm.bp_code LIKE concat(CONCAT('%',#{bpCode}),'%')

select * from ( select hbm.bp_id, hbm.bp_code, hbm.bp_name, (select hbc.description from hls_bp_category hbc where hbc.bp_category = hbmr.bp_type) bp_category from hls_bp_master_role hbmr inner join hls_bp_master hbm on hbmr.bp_id = hbm.bp_id where hbmr.bp_type in ('VENDER','DEALER','MANAGEMENT_COMPANY')
and hbm.bp_name LIKE concat(CONCAT('%',#{bpName}),'%')
and hbm.bp_code LIKE concat(CONCAT('%',#{bpCode}),'%')
)v
and v.bp_category LIKE concat(CONCAT('%',#{bpCategory}),'%')

select hbc.description bp_category, hbm.bp_id, hbm.bp_name from hls_bp_master hbm, hls_bp_category hbc
hbm.bp_type in ('MANUFACTURER', 'PARTNER') and hbm.enabled_flag = 'Y' and hbm.bp_type = hbc.BP_CATEGORY and hbc.enabled_flag = 'Y'
and hbc.description = #{bpCategory}
and hbm.bp_name like concat('%',concat(#{bpName},'%'))

select v.* from (SELECT (SELECT A.DESCRIPTION FROM HLS_BP_CATEGORY A WHERE A.BP_CATEGORY = HBM.BP_CATEGORY AND A.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y') bp_category, HBM.BP_NAME, (SELECT C.BP_NAME FROM HLS_BP_MASTER C WHERE C.BP_ID = HBMR.RELATED_BP_ID) relation_bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbm, hls_bp_master_relation hbmr where exists (select 1 from hls_bp_master_role r where r.bp_id = hbm.bp_id and r.bp_type in ('VENDER', 'PARTNER')) and hbmr.bp_id = hbm.bp_id and hbmr.enabled_flag = 'Y') v
and v.bp_category = #{bpCategory}
and v.bp_name like concat('%',concat(#{bpName},'%'))
and v.relation_bp_name like concat('%',concat(#{relationBpName},'%'))

select hbc.description bp_category, hbm.bp_id, hbm.bp_name from hls_bp_master hbm, hls_bp_category hbc
hbm.bp_type in ('DEALER') and hbm.enabled_flag = 'Y' and hbm.bp_type = hbc.bp_category and hbc.enabled_flag = 'Y'
and hbc.description = #{bpCategory}
and hbm.bp_name like concat('%',concat(#{bpName},'%'))

SELECT hbm.*, hbt.description bpClassN, hbpt.description bpTypeN, su.user_name ownerUserIdN, ( SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v. CODE = 'HLS211_ID_TYPE' AND v.code_value = ID_TYPE )idTypeN, ( SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v. CODE = 'HLS211_ID_TYPE' AND v.code_value = ID_TYPE_SP )idTypeSpN, ( SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v. CODE = 'HLS211_BP_TITLE' AND v.code_value = BP_TITLE )bpTitleN, ( SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v. CODE = 'HLS211_GENDER' AND v.code_value = GENDER )genderN, ( SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v. CODE = 'HLS211_MARITAL_STATUS' AND v.code_value = MARITAL_STATUS )maritalStatusN, ( SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v. CODE = 'HLS211_ACADEMIC_BACKGROUND' AND v.code_value = ACADEMIC_BACKGROUND )academicBackgroundN, ( SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v. CODE = 'HLS211_ACADEMIC_BACKGROUND' AND v.code_value = ACADEMIC_BACKGROUND_SP )academicBackgroundSpN, (select c.description from fnd_country c where c.country = hbm.country_sp) as countrySpN, (select p.description from fnd_province p where p.province = hbm.province_sp) as provinceSpN, (select c.description from fnd_city c where c.city = hbm.city_sp) as citySpN, (select d.description from fnd_district d where d.district = hbm.district_sp) as districtSpN, ( select country_name from fnd_country where country = nationality ) nationalityN, (select currency_name from fnd_currency where currency_code = currency) currencyN, (select bc.description from hls_bp_category bc where bc.bp_category = hbm.bp_category) as bpCategoryN, (select DESCRIPTION from hls_stat_class where CLASS_USAGE = 'BIZ_PARTNER' and CLASS_CODE = hbm.INDUSTRY) industry_n FROM hls_bp_master hbm LEFT JOIN hls_business_type hbt ON hbm.bp_class = hbt.business_type AND hbt.document_category = 'HLS_BP_MASTER' LEFT JOIN hls_bp_type hbpt ON hbm.bp_type = hbpt.bp_type LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON hbm.owner_user_id = su.user_id
and hbm.bp_id = #{bpId}
select bp_code as bp_code, bp_code bp_code_n from hls_bp_master

select code_value value_code, meaning value_name from sys_code_value_b_v where code = 'ZX_CERTORG_TYPE'
select code_value value_code, meaning value_name from sys_code_value_b_v where code = 'ZX_STOCKHOLDERTYPE'
select code_value value_code, meaning value_name from sys_code_value_b_v where code = 'ZX_AFFILIATEDTYPE'

SELECT pp.PROJECT_STATUS FROM PRJ_PROJECT pp WHERE pp.TENANT_ID = #{bpId} AND pp.PROJECT_STATUS IN ('APPROVING', 'APPROVED')
select bp_code from hls_bp_master where rownum = 1 order by CREATION_DATE desc

select hbm.bp_name , hbm.bp_code from hls_bp_master hbm
AND hbm.bp_name LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{bpName}),'%')
AND hbm.bp_code LIKE CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{bpCode}),'%')

SELECT * FROM (SELECT fd.DISTRICT tree_node_id, fd.DISTRICT value_code, ( SELECT CONCAT( CONCAT( fp.DESCRIPTION, fc.DESCRIPTION ), fd1.DESCRIPTION ) DESCRIPTION FROM FND_CITY fc INNER JOIN FND_DISTRICT fd1 ON TO_CHAR( fc.CITY ) = TO_CHAR( fd1.CITY ) AND TO_CHAR( fc.PROVINCE ) = TO_CHAR( fd1.PROVINCE ) INNER JOIN FND_PROVINCE fp ON TO_CHAR( fp.PROVINCE ) = TO_CHAR( fd1.PROVINCE ) WHERE fd.district = fd1.district ) value_name, fd.CITY parent_tree_node_id, fd.ENABLED_FLAG ENABLED_FLAG, ( SELECT CONCAT( CONCAT( fp.DESCRIPTION, fc.DESCRIPTION ), fd1.DESCRIPTION ) DESCRIPTION FROM FND_CITY fc INNER JOIN FND_DISTRICT fd1 ON TO_CHAR( fc.CITY ) = TO_CHAR( fd1.CITY ) AND TO_CHAR( fc.PROVINCE ) = TO_CHAR( fd1.PROVINCE ) INNER JOIN FND_PROVINCE fp ON TO_CHAR( fp.PROVINCE ) = TO_CHAR( fd1.PROVINCE ) WHERE fd.district = fd1.district ) tree_node_desc FROM FND_DISTRICT fd UNION ALL SELECT TO_CHAR( fc.CITY ) tree_node_id, TO_CHAR( fc.CITY ) value_code, ( SELECT CONCAT( fp1.DESCRIPTION, fc1.DESCRIPTION ) DESCRIPTION FROM FND_CITY fc1 INNER JOIN FND_PROVINCE fp1 ON fc1.PROVINCE = fp1.PROVINCE WHERE fc.CITY = fc1.CITY ) value_name, fc.PROVINCE parent_tree_node_id, fc.ENABLED_FLAG ENABLED_FLAG, ( SELECT CONCAT( fp1.DESCRIPTION, fc1.DESCRIPTION ) DESCRIPTION FROM FND_CITY fc1 INNER JOIN FND_PROVINCE fp1 ON fc1.PROVINCE = fp1.PROVINCE WHERE fc.CITY = fc1.CITY ) tree_node_desc FROM FND_CITY fc UNION ALL SELECT TO_CHAR( fp.PROVINCE ) tree_node_id, TO_CHAR( fp.PROVINCE ) value_code, fp.DESCRIPTION value_name, NULL parent_tree_node_id, fp.ENABLED_FLAG, fp.description tree_node_desc FROM FND_PROVINCE fp ) t
t.enabled_flag = 'Y'
and t.description like concat('%',concat(#{treeNodeDesc},'%'))
and t.description like concat('%',concat(#{tree_node_desc},'%'))

select t.class_code, t.class_id tree_node_id, t.class_id value_code, t.description value_name, t.parent_class_id parent_tree_node_id, t.expand_flag, t.order_seq, t.description tree_node_desc from hls_stat_class t
class_usage = 'BIZ_PARTNER'
and t.description like concat('%',concat(#{treeNodeDesc},'%'))
and t.description like concat('%',concat(#{tree_node_desc},'%'))
ORDER BY t.CLASS_ID

SELECT t.* FROM ( SELECT v.code_value_id tree_node_id, v.code_value_id value_code, v.code_value, v.MEANING value_name, v.parent_code_value_id parent_tree_node_id, v.MEANING tree_node_desc FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE V.CODE IN ( 'BUSINESS_OPERATION_B', 'BUSINESS_OPERATION_M', 'BUSINESS_OPERATION_L' ) AND FIND_IN_SET( v.code_value_id, getChildList (v.code_value_id) ) ORDER BY code_id ) t
and t.description like concat('%',concat(#{treeNodeDesc},'%'))
and t.description like concat('%',concat(#{tree_node_desc},'%'))

select t.* from (SELECT v.code_value_id tree_node_id, v.code_value_id value_code, v.code_value, v.MEANING value_name, v.parent_code_value_id parent_tree_node_id, v.MEANING tree_node_desc FROM sys_code_value_b_v v where V.code IN ('FND.ORGTYPESUB', 'FND.ORGTYPE') and FIND_IN_SET(v.code_value_id,getChildList(v.code_value_id)) != 0 order by code_id) t
and t.description like concat('%',concat(#{treeNodeDesc},'%'))
and t.description like concat('%',concat(#{tree_node_desc},'%'))

SELECT t.* FROM ( SELECT v.code_value_id tree_node_id, v.code_value_id value_code, v.code_value, v.MEANING value_name, v.parent_code_value_id parent_tree_node_id, v.MEANING tree_node_desc FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE V.CODE IN ( 'BP.ECONOMIC_SECTOR', 'BP.ECONOMIC_SECTOR_SEC', 'BP.ECONOMIC_SECTOR_THR' ) AND FIND_IN_SET(v.code_value_id ,getChildList(v.code_value_id )) != 0 ORDER BY v.code_id ) t
and t.description like concat('%',concat(#{treeNodeDesc},'%'))
and t.description like concat('%',concat(#{tree_node_desc},'%'))

select t1.* from ( select bp.bp_id, bp.bp_code, bp.bp_name, bp.bp_type, bp.bp_class, bp.bp_category, bp.bank_short_name, bp.extra_nam, bp.fin_org_type, bp.rele_com_flag, ( SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v. CODE = 'CSH.BANK_ORG_TYPE' and v.code_value=bp.fin_org_type) fin_org_type_n, ( SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v. CODE = 'SYS.YES_NO' and v.code_value=bp.rele_com_flag) rele_com_flag_n, bp.BANK_CODE, (select hbc.description from hls_bp_category hbc where hbc.bp_category=bp.BP_CATEGORY) bp_category_n, (select hbt.description from hls_bp_type hbt where hbt.bp_category=bp.BP_CATEGORY and hbt.bp_type=bp.BP_TYPE) bp_type_n, bp.ENTERPRISE_UNIFIED_CREDITCODE, bp.LEGAL_REPRESENTATIVE, bp.START_ACTIVE_DATE, bp.END_ACTIVE_DATE, bp.CREATION_DATE, bp.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, bp.OWNER_USER_ID, (select su.DESCRIPTION from sys_user su where su.USER_ID=bp.OWNER_USER_ID ) user_id_n, bp.FIN_NOTE, bp.bank_id, (select cb.bank_name from csh_bank cb where cb.bank_id=bp.bank_id) bank_id_n, BP.CREATED_BY, ( SELECT su.DESCRIPTION FROM sys_user su WHERE su.USER_ID = bp.CREATED_BY ) AS CREATE_N from hls_bp_master bp
) t1
t1.bp_category in('HLS_BP_CREDIT','CREDIT_ORGANIZATION')
and t1.bp_id = #{bpId}
and t1.bp_code like CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{bpCode}),'%')
and t1.bp_name like CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{bpName}),'%')
and t1.bank_short_name like CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{bankShortName}),'%')
and t1.fin_org_type like CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{finOrgType}),'%')
and t1.bp_type like CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{bpType}),'%')
and t1.create_n like CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{createN}),'%')
order by t1.CREATION_DATE DESC

select bma.bp_id, bma.bp_attachment_id, bma.document_name, bma.description, (select wm_concat(faa.file_name) modelName from fnd_atm_attachment faa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi faam where faam.record_id = faa.source_pk_value and faam.table_pk_value = to_char(bma.bp_attachment_id) and faam.table_name = 'bp_master_attachment' and bma.bp_attachment_category = 'LON_CONTRACT') file_names, (select max(faa.creation_date) last_upload_time from fnd_atm_attachment faa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi faam where faam.record_id = faa.source_pk_value and faam.table_pk_value = to_char(bma.bp_attachment_id) and faam.table_name = 'bp_master_attachment' and bma.bp_attachment_category = 'LON_CONTRACT') last_upload_time from bp_master_attachment bma where bma.bp_id = #{bpId}

select hbm.bp_id,hbm.bp_code,hbm.bp_name,hbm.BP_TYPE,hbm.BP_CATEGORY,hbm.FIN_ORG_TYPE from hls_bp_master hbm
hbm.bp_category='CREDIT_ORGANIZATION'
and hbm.bp_code like CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{bpCode}),'%')
and hbm.bp_name like CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{bpName}),'%')

select bp.bp_id, bp.bp_code, bp.bp_name, bp.bp_type, bp.bp_class, bp.bp_category, bp.bank_short_name, bp.fin_org_type, bp.bp_classify, bp.sub_branch, (select scvb.meaning as value_name from sys_code_value_b scvb, sys_code_b scb where scb.code ='BP_CLASSIFY' and scb.code_id = scvb.code_id and scvb.enabled_flag = 'Y' and scvb.value = bp.bp_classify ) bp_classify_n, ( SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v. CODE = 'CSH.BANK_ORG_TYPE' and v.code_value=bp.fin_org_type) fin_org_type_n, bp.BANK_CODE, (select hbc.description from hls_bp_category hbc where hbc.bp_category=bp.BP_CATEGORY) bp_category_n, (select scvb.meaning from sys_code_value_b scvb, sys_code_b scb where scb.code ='FIN.BP_TYPE' and scb.code_id = scvb.code_id and scvb.enabled_flag = 'Y' and scvb.value=bp.BP_TYPE)as bp_type_n, bp.ENTERPRISE_UNIFIED_CREDITCODE, bp.START_ACTIVE_DATE, bp.END_ACTIVE_DATE, bp.CREATION_DATE, bp.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, bp.OWNER_USER_ID, (select su.DESCRIPTION from sys_user su where su.USER_ID=bp.OWNER_USER_ID ) user_id_n, bp.FIN_NOTE, bp.finance_manager, (SELECT u.description FROM sys_user u WHERE u.user_id = bp.finance_manager) finance_manager_n
from hls_bp_master bp
bp.bp_category = 'CREDIT_ORGANIZATION'
and bp.bp_id = #{bpId}
and bp.review_status = #{reviewStatus}
and bp.bp_code like CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{bpCode}),'%')
and bp.bp_name like CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{bpName}),'%')
and bp.bank_short_name like CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{bankShortName}),'%')
and bp.fin_org_type like CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{finOrgType}),'%')
and bp.bp_type like CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{bpType}),'%')
and (SELECT u.description FROM sys_user u WHERE u.user_id = bp.finance_manager ) like CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{financeManagerN}),'%')
order by bp.CREATION_DATE DESC

select hbc.bp_category, hbc.description as category_desc, hbt.bp_type, hbt.description as type_desc from hls_bp_category hbc, hls_bp_type hbt
hbc.bp_category = hbt.bp_category and hbc.enabled_flag = 'Y' and hbt.enabled_flag = 'Y'
and hbc.bp_category in ('VENDER','DEALER') and hbt.bp_type in ('VENDER','DEALER')
and hbc.bp_category not in ('VENDER','DEALER','MANUFACTURER','PARTNER')
and hbc.bp_category like CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{bp_category}),'%')
and hbc.description like CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{category_desc}),'%')
and hbt.bp_type like CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{bp_type}),'%')
and hbt.description like CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{type_desc}),'%')
select hbm.* from hls_bp_master hbm where hbm.bp_type in ('PARTNER', 'MANUFACTURER')

SELECT hbm.bp_id, (SELECT hbc.description FROM hls_bp_category hbc WHERE hbm.bp_type = hbc.bp_category AND hbc.enabled_flag = 'Y') bp_category, hbm.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbm WHERE hbm.bp_type IN ('PARTNER', 'MANUFACTURER') AND hbm.enabled_flag = 'Y'
